content.comment_body: Hi, I'm trying to divide two outputs from different analog amplifiers. My setup uses a potentiometer to measure rotation percentage, but the range doesn't reach the full span, so calibration is needed. For example, if my potentiometer operates between 2V and 8V out of a possible 0V to 10V, and stops at 5V, the output calculation is ((5 - 2) / (8 - 2)) * 100. I've programmed it so far that I get the numerator and denominator, but I'm struggling to perform the division and multiplication. I attempted to use the mathematic instruction, but the analog amplifier block's outputs aren't compatible. Any advice would be very helpful. Thank you!
Check out this [company_name] FAQ on configuring references between blocks in [product_name] [version_no].
Thanks for sharing! I missed such a simple solution—appreciate the help.

The key issue was a lack of clear guidance on integrating different instruction blocks, leading to confusion until pointed to relevant documentation.
